$comment: Swedish typography: ”…” with the closing mark on both sides (macOS sv: Finder `Radera skivan ”%@”`, `Vill du radera ”%@”?`), nested ’…’ likewise (Svenska skrivregler), and ’ as the apostrophe. Schema: docs/i18n/termbase.md § <tag>/mechanics.json schema.

spacing.why: Swedish puts a space between a number and % (`100 %`, `{percent} %`)

hedges.why: a bracketed plural or definite ending (`fil(er)`, `mapp(en)`, `objekt(et)`); use ICU plural, or rephrase
a slashed ending (`markerad/-t`, `fil/er`); use ICU plural or select, or rephrase so nothing agrees
a slashed article or pronoun that dodges en/ett gender; name the noun (`filen`, `objektet`) or rephrase

an ending or genitive glued to an insert (`{name}s`, `{name}:s`, `{system_settings}en`) depends on how the value sounds; use a preposition (`på {name}`, `från {host}`). A hyphenated compound (`{mode}-sökning`, `.git`-mappen) is fine
